question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage mentions** the recommended amount of fruit and vegetable intake for good health.**
 
• The** context suggests that most Indians are not consuming the recommended quantities of fruits and vegetables**.
 
• "**Enough**" is the appropriate word to describe the insufficient quantity of fruits and vegetables consumed by most Indians.

The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 4 is 'enough.'

Therefore, the correct sentence from the passage should read **"****Eat five kinds of vegetables and two kinds of fruit every day for good health. Most Indians do not eat enough__ fruit and vegetables."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("some", "many", "plenty") do not accurately reflect the idea of not meeting the required intake.

 
• **Some** (कुछ): "Some" means an unspecified amount, which does not indicate a clear shortage as required by the context.
 
• **Many (**बहुत): "Many" refers to a large number, which is the opposite of the intended meaning of insufficiency.
 
• **Plenty** (बहुतायत): "Plenty" means more than enough, which does not fit the context of describing a shortage or lack.
